environment.cpp_toolchain: absent: g++, clang++, cl, cmake, make, ninja all missing
environment.consequence: the C++ module of item 3 is written and self-checked by inspection and by generated reference vectors, but is NOT compiled or executed here; the 1D coupling of items 4-9 is demonstrated in an isolated Python mirror of the P1-R2 closures

column_cells.provenance: declared base grid; convergence demonstrated at 40, 80, 160

seed_height_m.provenance: declared smaller than the 1e-4 m seed of P2-A/P2-B, and why: at the Case 36877 soil state a 100 um crust at eps_0 = 0.43 holds 0.123 kg/m2 of NaCl, which is 44 percent of the entire 0.2 m column's 0.279 kg/m2 inventory. That is not a minimal perturbation of the soil. A 10 um seed holds 0.0137 kg/m2, about 4.9 percent, and is still about 19 reaction lengths thick, so it remains a continuum crust. Recorded before the coupled runs.

cells_per_reaction_length.provenance: P2-C grid-convergence gate; 4 is the minimum, 16 the production value there

interface_undersaturation_limit.provenance: declared: the Prat reduction assumes a halite-equilibrated base, so an interface more than 2 percent below C_eq in relative terms is reported as outside the audited envelope

seeding_trigger.value: soil top mass fraction reaches C_eq
seeding_trigger.provenance: declared: the crust is seeded only when the soil surface actually reaches halite saturation under the activity-controlled film, which is the physically consistent precondition item 6 asks for. No seed is created before that.

predictions_registered_before_measuremen.hydrostatic_steady_state: With no-flux top and bottom and a uniform mole fraction, the P1-R2 hydrostatic profile is an exact steady state of the mirror; inventories must not drift by more than 1e-12 relative over the test horizon.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.prescribed_flux_budget: With prescribed component fluxes the independently reconstructed inventory change equals the integrated boundary transfer to 1e-10 relative, for water, salt and total liquid separately.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.film_evaporation_falls: Under the water-activity-controlled film with a no-flux bottom, the surface concentrates, the water activity falls and the evaporation flux decreases monotonically in time; the integrated evaporation equals the water-inventory loss to the budget tolerance.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.salt_is_conserved_under_evaporation: With zero salt flux at the top and a no-flux bottom, the column salt inventory is constant to the budget tolerance however strongly the surface concentrates.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.crust_base_generalisation_reduces: Setting the crust base mass fraction to C_eq must reproduce the committed P2-C solve bit for bit, so every P2-C test must still pass unchanged.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.interface_has_a_unique_root: The interface residual g(w_i) = F_s,soil(w_i) - F_s,crust(w_i) is monotone in w_i over the admissible bracket, so the compatible interface concentration is unique.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.three_route_closure: At the converged interface the independently reconstructed crust transport flux, the crust inventory rate and the soil component flux agree to the declared tolerance; none of the three is computed from another.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.undersaturated_base_is_refused: If the compatible interface mass fraction falls below C_eq by more than the declared relative limit, the reduced Prat closure is outside its audited envelope and the model stops instead of extrapolating.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.seeding_is_reached_by_evaporation: Under the declared film and a no-flux bottom the Case 36877 soil surface reaches halite saturation in finite time, so the seed is produced by the model rather than prescribed at t = 0.
predictions_registered_before_measuremen.seed_is_budget_neutral: Forming the seed from the soil's own top-cell salt and water leaves the combined soil+crust NaCl inventory exactly unchanged at t = 0.

limitations: The column is a cell-centred 1D finite-volume mirror of P1-R2's closures, not P1-R2 itself; P1-R2 is a 2D vertex-centred box scheme and could not be built in this environment.
The C++ module is not compiled or executed here.
No 2D instability run is performed, and no frozen P1-R2 result is touched.
A closing budget verifies the implementation, not the physics of either closure.
